html:
G'oya

Ikki bosqich. Avval safarlardan kunlarni yasaymiz: haydovchi va kun bo'yicha guruhlab, HAVING SUM(fare) >= 300000 bilan reja bajarilgan kunlarni qoldiramiz. Keyin bu kunlarda ketma-ket seriyalarni topamiz: ketma-ket kunlarda day - ROW_NUMBER() bir xil chiqadi, u seriyaning "nomi" bo'ladi. Seriyalarni sanab, eng uzunini olamiz.

Yechim

WITH plan_days AS (
  SELECT driver, day
  FROM trips
  GROUP BY driver, day
  HAVING SUM(fare) >= 300000
),
grp AS (
  SELECT driver,
         day - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY driver ORDER BY day) AS g
  FROM plan_days
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT driver, COUNT(*) AS len
  FROM grp
  GROUP BY driver, g
)
SELECT d.driver, COALESCE(MAX(s.len), 0) AS best_streak
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT driver FROM trips) d
LEFT JOIN streaks s ON s.driver = d.driver
GROUP BY d.driver

Azizning reja kunlari 1, 2, 4, 5, 6. Tartib raqamlari 1 dan 5 gacha, ayirmalar 0, 0, 1, 1, 1: ikki seriya, 2 va 3 kunlik. Oxiridagi LEFT JOIN Jasurni saqlab qoladi: uning reja kuni yo'q, MAX NULL beradi va COALESCE uni 0 qiladi.

Tuzoqlar

Har safarni alohida tekshirish. Azizning 1-kuni ikki safar: 180 000 va 150 000. Hech biri 300 000 emas, lekin kunlik tushum 330 000 va reja bajarilgan. WHERE fare >= 300000 bu kunni yo'qotadi.

Rejasiz haydovchilarni unutish. Seriyalardan boshlangan so'rovda Jasur umuman chiqmaydi:

Noto'g'riWITH plan_days AS (
  SELECT driver, day FROM trips
  GROUP BY driver, day
  HAVING SUM(fare) >= 300000
),
grp AS (
  SELECT driver, day - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY driver ORDER BY day) AS g
  FROM plan_days
)
SELECT driver, MAX(c) AS best_streak
FROM (SELECT driver, g, COUNT(*) AS c FROM grp GROUP BY driver, g) s
GROUP BY driver

Ayirma usuli kunlar takrorlanmasa ishlaydi. Bu yerda takror yo'q, chunki plan_days allaqachon guruhlangan: bir kun bir qator.
